import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { Link, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'; const LegalPolicyPage = ({ defaultTab = 'privacy' }) => { const location = useLocation(); const getTabFromPath = () => { if (location.pathname.includes('/privacy')) return 'privacy'; if (location.pathname.includes('/terms')) return 'terms'; if (location.pathname.includes('/cookies')) return 'cookies'; if (location.pathname.includes('/refund')) return 'refund'; return defaultTab; }; const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(getTabFromPath()); const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState(''); const [copiedLink, setCopiedLink] = useState(false); const [showScrollTop, setShowScrollTop] = useState(false); useEffect(() => { setActiveTab(getTabFromPath()); window.scrollTo(0, 0); }, [location.pathname]); useEffect(() => { const handleScroll = () => { if (window.scrollY > 300) { setShowScrollTop(true); } else { setShowScrollTop(false); } }; window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll); return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll); }, []); const scrollToTop = () => { window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); }; const copyPageLink = () => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href); setCopiedLink(true); setTimeout(() => setCopiedLink(false), 3000); }; const handlePrint = () => { window.print(); }; const policies = { privacy: { title: 'Privacy Policy', subtitle: 'How VehicleRentX collects, uses, stores, and safeguards your personal data.', effectiveDate: 'Effective Date: July 2026', icon: 'fa-shield-halved', sections: [ { id: 'intro', title: '1. Introduction', content: ( <>

VehicleRentX values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your data when you use our smart campus mobility platform.

By creating an account or accessing VehicleRentX services, you consent to the data collection and usage practices described in this policy.
) }, { id: 'collection', title: '2. Information We Collect', content: ( <>

We collect essential information to provide secure and seamless vehicle rentals:

Personal & Academic Data
  • Full Name & Choose Username
  • Email Address & Mobile Phone Number
  • Encrypted Password Hash
  • University / Institute Name & Type
  • Academic Course, Department & Semester
  • Student / Employee Roll Number
KYC & Booking Information
  • Aadhaar Card (Front & Back Scans)
  • Driving License Verification
  • Selfie Verification Photo
  • Vehicle Ownership & RC Documents (For Owners)
  • Booking History, Durations & Trip Logs
  • Wallet Balance & PayPal Transaction Logs
) }, { id: 'usage', title: '3. How We Use Your Information', content: ( <>

Your personal and technical data is used exclusively to facilitate reliable campus transit:

  • Create and securely authenticate user accounts across campus.
  • Verify student and staff eligibility via campus identification & KYC.
  • Process ride reservations, digital wallet payments, and security deposits.
  • Send automated SMS OTPs, booking confirmations, and critical alerts.
  • Detect fraudulent activities, unauthorized vehicle usage, and safety violations.
  • Provide prompt customer support and resolve technical queries.
  • Comply with applicable legal, institutional, and regulatory obligations.
) }, { id: 'security', title: '4. Data Security & Storage', content: ( <>

VehicleRentX employs robust, industry-standard technical security controls to safeguard your data:

HTTPS SSL/TLS Encrypted Transmission
BCrypt Password Hashing
SMS Mobile OTP Verification
Role-Based Database Access
) }, { id: 'sharing', title: '5. Information Sharing & Disclosure', content: ( <>

VehicleRentX does not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. Data is shared only under strict operational necessity:

  • Payment Processors: Secure transaction details shared with PayPal for wallet top-ups.
  • Gateway Partners: Mobile numbers shared with SMS providers (Fast2SMS/MSG91) solely for OTP delivery.
  • Legal Compliance: Disclosed to university authorities or law enforcement agencies when mandated by law.
) }, { id: 'rights', title: '6. User Rights & Data Deletion', content: ( <>

Users possess full control over their personal profile and stored data:

  • View and update academic profile details anytime in account settings.
  • Request complete account deactivation and personal data deletion.
  • Inquire about stored KYC document records and access logs.
) } ] }, terms: { title: 'Terms & Conditions', subtitle: 'Rules, guidelines, and legal terms governing the use of VehicleRentX.', effectiveDate: 'Effective Date: July 2026', icon: 'fa-file-contract', sections: [ { id: 'terms-intro', title: '1. Introduction & Agreement', content: ( <>

By registering, logging in, or using VehicleRentX, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you must not use the platform.

) }, { id: 'eligibility', title: '2. User Eligibility', content: ( <>

To register and rent vehicles on VehicleRentX, you must satisfy the following criteria:

  • Be at least 18 years of age.
  • Be an active student, faculty member, research scholar, or verified staff member of a participating institution.
  • Successfully complete mandatory identity verification (Aadhaar & Driving License).
  • Provide accurate, truthful, and up-to-date registration details.
) }, { id: 'user-resp', title: '3. Rider Responsibilities', content: ( <>
Rider Obligations
  • Adhere strictly to speed limits and traffic safety regulations.
  • Inspect vehicles for existing damage prior to unlocking.
  • Return rented vehicles on or before the specified check-in time.
  • Park vehicles only at designated, authorized campus parking stands.
  • Report any breakdown, accident, or malfunction immediately to support.
) }, { id: 'owner-resp', title: '4. Vehicle Owner Responsibilities', content: ( <>

Students or faculty members listing their personal vehicles on VehicleRentX must ensure:

  • Vehicles hold valid Registration Certificates (RC) and active third-party insurance.
  • Vehicles are maintained in safe, roadworthy operating condition.
  • Confirmed user bookings are honored promptly without unannounced cancellations.
) }, { id: 'prohibited', title: '5. Prohibited Conduct & Violations', content: ( <>
Strictly Forbidden Actions
  • Operating vehicles under the influence of alcohol, drugs, or intoxicating substances.
  • Sub-leasing, sharing, or transferring account credentials to third parties.
  • Using vehicles for commercial haulage, illegal activities, or stunt riding.
  • Submitting falsified or altered KYC identification documents.
) }, { id: 'suspension', title: '6. Account Suspension & Termination', content: ( <>

VehicleRentX reserves the unconditional right to suspend, terminate, or restrict account access for users engaging in fraudulent activities, safety violations, or repeated policy non-compliance.

) } ] }, cookies: { title: 'Cookie Policy', subtitle: 'Information on how VehicleRentX uses cookies and tracking technologies.', effectiveDate: 'Effective Date: July 2026', icon: 'fa-cookie-bite', sections: [ { id: 'cookie-intro', title: '1. What Are Cookies?', content: ( <>

Cookies are small data files stored on your browser or device when you visit websites. VehicleRentX utilizes cookies to enable essential features, maintain active authentication sessions, and personalize user experiences.

) }, { id: 'types', title: '2. Types of Cookies We Use', content: ( <>
Cookie Category Purpose Duration
Essential Session Cookies Maintains secure user login and active navigation tokens. Session / 24 Hours
Security Cookies Prevents Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) & unauthorized access. Persistent
Preference Cookies Remembers selected campus location & filter settings. 30 Days
Performance Analytics Monitors page load speeds & system response times. 90 Days
) }, { id: 'manage-cookies', title: '3. Managing Cookie Preferences', content: ( <>

You can control and manage cookie settings directly in your web browser preferences. Please note that disabling essential cookies may impact authentication and interactive features on VehicleRentX.

) } ] }, refund: { title: 'Refund & Cancellation Policy', subtitle: 'Transparent guidelines regarding rental cancellations, security deposits, and wallet refunds.', effectiveDate: 'Effective Date: July 2026', icon: 'fa-receipt', sections: [ { id: 'refund-intro', title: '1. Overview & Principles', content: ( <>

VehicleRentX guarantees fair, automated, and transparent refund processing for eligible trip cancellations, technical glitches, or double debits.

) }, { id: 'eligible', title: '2. Eligible Refund Conditions', content: ( <>

Full or partial refunds are automatically approved under the following conditions:

  • Vehicle is unavailable at the designated stand following booking confirmation.
  • Rental booking is cancelled by the vehicle owner prior to trip initiation.
  • Duplicate billing or transaction error occurs during PayPal wallet top-ups.
  • Unforeseen technical system failures prevent vehicle unlock or trip completion.
) }, { id: 'timelines', title: '3. Refund Processing Timelines', content: ( <>
Payment Method Processing Time Destination
VehicleRentX Wallet Within 24 Hours In-app Wallet Credit
UPI / Direct Payment 1 – 3 Business Days Source Bank Account
Debit / Credit Card 3 – 7 Business Days Card Issuing Bank
Bank Transfer / PayPal 3 – 7 Business Days Original Payment Source
) }, { id: 'non-refundable', title: '4. Non-Refundable Scenarios', content: ( <>
Non-Refundable Exceptions
  • User no-show or failure to collect vehicle without prior cancellation.
  • Cancellations attempted after vehicle unlock or trip commencement.
  • Accidental damage or policy violations resulting in account suspension.
) } ] } }; const currentPolicy = policies[activeTab] || policies.privacy; const filteredSections = currentPolicy.sections.filter(sec => sec.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) || sec.id.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ); return (
